answer: The network plants decoy "leaked answer" texts in channels that scraping farms harvest. Any identity submitting a decoy is provably inside a copying pipeline, so its bond burns on the spot with no quality judgment needed. The vine of decoys is regenerated from the beacon each epoch, so yesterday's bait is worthless; one caught submission is a signal that freezes the whole funding cluster, and the plume of linked accounts goes to review. Honest agents never see the bait, so the trap costs them nothing.
